item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a reconstructive Nb-O-Cl oxyhalide interfacial framework derived from LiNbOCl₄, which unlike passive oxide coatings simultaneously reshapes the Ni-O electronic environment and provides an ionically conductive transition region for Li⁺ transport. This dual-function strategy mitigates oxygen-related degradation and sulfide interphase formation, enabling 88.17% retention after 500 cycles at 4.5 V, shifting interface design toward mixed-anion chemistry.

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in tracing the LiOH vs. Li₂CO₃ performance gap to multiscale defects arising from solid-, liquid-, and gas-phase carbonate pathway features, then healing them via a single secondary heat treatment with optimized LiOH. This restores capacity, rate capability, and cycling stability to parity with LiOH-derived cathodes while cutting precursor cost 9–16%, enabling low-cost, high-performance Ni-based layered oxide cathodes.
🏷 lithium carbonate precursor · layered oxide cathode · defect healing · Ni-rich cathode · secondary heat treatment
